takes.title: Salsa steps with low lunge, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps and turns with bent arms, drops into a deep wide lunge, then rises into more crossing steps and arm reaches.

takes.title: Salsa steps with arm reaches, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A begins standing, then shifts through small crossing steps and turns while extending and lifting the arms.

takes.title: Salsa steps and pivots, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A moves from hands on hips into small crossing steps and pivots, gesturing outward and across the chest.

takes.title: Salsa steps with raised arm, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps and turns with bent knees and hands held forward, briefly raising an arm before settling.

takes.title: Salsa steps with overhead gesture, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps sideways and pivots, lifts both hands near the head and later raises one arm while continuing small steps.

takes.title: Salsa crossing steps, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A repeats close crossing steps and turns with arms folded or gesturing near the chest, then slows to a stand.

takes.title: Salsa steps with broad arm gestures, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A alternates crossing steps and turns, extending one arm and later raising both arms before settling.

takes.title: Salsa steps and forward bend, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps and pivots with expressive arm gestures, raises an arm overhead, then bends forward near the end.

takes.title: Salsa steps with overhead reaches, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps and turns with bent arms, then makes several overhead and outward reaches before continuing smaller steps.

takes.title: Salsa steps and forward reach, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A starts with small steps and hands near the chest, turns and reaches forward while stepping, then settles.

takes.title: Salsa steps and low dip, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps and turns with alternating arm gestures, lowers into a brief crouched dip, then rises and stops.

takes.title: Salsa steps with pointing reach, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A uses small crossing steps and turns, extends an arm outward and upward, and finishes standing.

takes.title: Salsa steps with forward reaches, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps and turns with hands near the chest, then reaches both arms forward and opens into a wider stance.

takes.title: Salsa steps and arm sweep, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A moves through crossing and wider steps with bent arms, sweeping an arm outward while turning.

takes.title: Salsa side steps and turn, participant A
takes.actionDescription: Participant A steps into a wide stance and turns, then resumes smaller steps with a hand passing near the head before stopping.
